rows.en: ＊Rei＊＠１０９＿００１Hey! How long are you gonna￥slack off in a place like this?!＝＠１０９＿００２I already went and signed you up￥as part of the mechanic crew,￥got it?!
＊Rei＊＠１０９＿００３You start work today!! C'mon,￥I'll teach you the details, so￥hurry up and follow me.
＊Rei＊＠１０９＿００４Move it! Dawdle like that and￥you'll never get done!

＊Rei＊＠１０９＿００５Alpha's gonna be reborn as a￥stop on the route linking Sophia￥and Elan.＝＠１０９＿００６We're gonna be busy as hell￥from here on out!＝＠１０９＿００７So you gotta turn into a￥mechanic worth a damn, fast.＝＠１０９＿００８We're short on hands over here!!

＊Rei＊＠１０９＿００９If you're fumbling a job that￥easy, you're never gonna be the￥real deal!＝＠１０９＿０１０I poached you 'cause I saw you￥had a knack for this, y'know.￥I'm expecting big things!＝＠１０９＿０１１You'll never top me, but I bet￥you could be second best.＝＠１０９＿０１２Me, I'd take five. For you...￥let's say ten minutes, tops!＝＠１０９＿０１３10 minutes. Get it done!
＊Rei＊＠１０９＿０１４Hurry it up!￥Look, three minutes already!!￥C'mon, c'mon, quit draggin'...
